resources.name: Zeolite structure and XRD data (IZA-SC database / Atlas of Zeolite Framework Types / Collection of Simulated XRD Powder Patterns)

access.notes: The dataset of 131 zeolites must be compiled from the IZA-SC database and simulated XRD patterns from Treacy & Higgins (2001) and Baerlocher et al. (2001) Atlas of Zeolite Framework Types. The agent extracts the eight highest-intensity 2θ peak angles and the corresponding ground-truth structural parameters (r1, r2, fd, a, b, c).
